caption: The drawing is composed of two schematic, line-art illustrations on a beige background with small scattered brown spots. At the top, there is a semicircular object with a straight horizontal line extending from each end, forming a structure resembling a handled strainer or scoop. The semicircular part features a pattern of small dots, short dashes, and X-shaped marks arranged in several rows. Below this, there is a separate, unrelated object, shown in outline from the front; it has a broad base that curves inward to narrow at the top, then flares out into two symmetrical arms with decorative spiral ends, and a looped, double ring at the top center. Near this ring, there appears to be a small label with the word "WALTEN" inscribed. At the bottom left corner of the image, the text "WALTEN V.K." is written. The drawing uses only black lines and text, with no shading or color besides the paper's background tone.
title: Silver Strainer
